annual_fee.question: What is the annual base subscription fee?
annual_fee.answer: The annual base subscription fee is $240,000, payable quarterly in advance in installments of $60,000.

sources.quote: Client shall pay Provider an annual base subscription fee of $240,000, payable quarterly in advance in installments of $60,000.

notice_period.question: What is the notice period for convenience termination?
notice_period.answer: Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days prior written notice.

sources.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days prior written notice.

liability_cap.question: What is the liability cap under this contract?
liability_cap.answer: Provider's total aggregate liability is strictly capped at the fees actually paid by Client in the three (3) months preceding the claim.

sources.quote: PROVIDER'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE STRICTLY CAPPED AT THE FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY CLIENT IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

governing_law.question: Which law governs this agreement?
governing_law.answer: This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, with exclusive jurisdiction in New York County.

sources.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict of laws principles.

sla.answer: The uploaded document does not contain information sufficient to answer this question.

risks.title: Immediate Termination for Overdue Fees
risks.quote: Provider may terminate this Agreement immediately without notice if Client fails to pay undisputed fees within ten (10) days of overdue notice.
risks.business_impact: Provider can cancel services abruptly with only a 10-day notice window, risking immediate operational shutdown.
risks.lawyer_question: Can we negotiate a 30-day cure period and eliminate immediate unilateral termination?

risks.title: Severe 3-Month Liability Cap
risks.quote: PROVIDER'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE STRICTLY CAPPED AT THE FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY CLIENT IN THE THREE (3) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
risks.business_impact: Recovery for catastrophic service outage is capped at only 3 months of fees ($60,000) against an annual commitment of $240,000.
risks.lawyer_question: Should the liability cap be increased to at least 12 months of fees or total contract value?

risks.title: 24-Month Non-Solicitation
risks.quote: Client agrees not to solicit or hire any of Provider's employees or contractors for a period of twenty-four (24) months following termination of this Agreement.
risks.business_impact: Restricts client recruitment and hiring for 2 full years after contract termination.
risks.lawyer_question: Can this non-solicitation period be reduced to 6 or 12 months?
